    • Constructor Detail

      • Procedure

        public Procedure(Token t,
                 Body b,
                 Scope filescope,
                 boolean pvt)
        Construct a procedure definition.
        Parameters:
        t - is the procedure identifier token which provides both the procedure identifier and the source file location of the definition
        b - is the enclosing module, procedure or function or is null for a file module
        filescope - is the file scope for the module
        pvt - is true if this procedure is declared as 'private'

    • Method Detail

      • execute

        public void execute(NodeList inargs,
                    NodeList outargs,
                    TDEVar esig,
                    java.util.ArrayList<TDEVar> startl,
                    java.util.ArrayList<TDEVar> finishl,
                    QueueRefs queues,
                    boolean toplevel,
                    boolean availok,
                    QueueRefs checkedqueues,
                    TDEVar pri_in,
                    TDEVar pri_out)
        Execute a user-defined procedure.
        Parameters:
        inargs - is a list of input argument tree nodes
        outargs - is a list of output argument tree nodes
        esig - is an exception/restart signal, or null
        startl - is a list of start signals for target statements below this node
        finishl - is a list of finish signals for target statements below this node
        queues - returns all the queue availability signals accumulated from code below
        toplevel - is true if this is the top level in a module
        availok - is true if a previous sync makes a queue availability wait unnecessary
        checkedqueues - gives queue reads which have already been checked
        pri_in - is an optional input signal to a priority encoder
        pri_out - is an optional output signal from a priority encoder
